description: Quantify the phylogenetic distribution of the erg13 duplication across Compara fungal species and summarize the unsaturated rate comparison
code:
import json, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np
h=json.load(open("erg13_compara_homology.json"))
Ah={}; Bh={}
for x in h["erg13A"]:
    if x["type"].startswith("ortholog"): Ah.setdefault(x["target"]["species"],set()).add(x["target"]["id"])
for x in h["erg13B"]:
    if x["type"].startswith("ortholog"): Bh.setdefault(x["target"]["species"],set()).add(x["target"]["id"])
allsp=sorted(set(Ah)|set(Bh))
cat={}
for s in allsp:
    a=Ah.get(s,set()); b=Bh.get(s,set())
    if a and b and (a-b) and (b-a):   cat[s]="two distinct copies (duplication retained)"
    elif a and b and a==b:            cat[s]="single gene co-orthologous to both"
    elif a and b:                     cat[s]="overlapping / ambiguous call"
    elif b and not a:                 cat[s]="B-type ortholog only (no A-type)"
    else:                             cat[s]="A-type ortholog only (no B-type)"
c=pd.Series(cat).value_counts()
print("Ensembl Compara fungi, ortholog calls for A. fumigatus erg13A (Afu8g07210) and erg13B (Afu3g10660)")
print(f"total species with any ortholog call: {len(allsp)}\n")
print(c.to_string())

two=[s for s in allsp if cat[s]=="two distinct copies (duplication retained)"]
print(f"\nSpecies retaining two distinct copies ({len(two)}):")
for s in sorted(two): print("   ", s, sorted(Ah[s])[0], sorted(Bh[s])[0])
onlyB=[s for s in allsp if cat[s]=="B-type ortholog only (no A-type)"]
onlyA=[s for s in allsp if cat[s]=="A-type ortholog only (no B-type)"]
print(f"\nB-type only: {len(onlyB)} species   |   A-type only: {len(onlyA)} species")
print("examples of B-type-only (no erg13A ortholog anywhere in the genome):")
for s in sorted(onlyB)[:10]: print("   ", s)

# within-species paralog call, independent confirmation
for lab in ["erg13A","erg13B"]:
    p=[x for x in h[lab] if x["type"]=="within_species_paralog"]
    for x in p:
        print(f"\nCompara within_species_paralog for {lab}: {x['target']['id']} "
              f"perc_id={x['target']['perc_id']:.1f}% subtype={x.get('taxonomy_level')}")

pd.DataFrame({"species":allsp,"category":[cat[s] for s in allsp],
              "A_genes":[",".join(sorted(Ah.get(s,[]))) for s in allsp],
              "B_genes":[",".join(sorted(Bh.get(s,[]))) for s in allsp]}
            ).to_csv("table8_compara_ortholog_distribution.csv", index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,4.6))
order=["two distinct copies (duplication retained)","single gene co-orthologous to both",
       "B-type ortholog only (no A-type)","A-type ortholog only (no B-type)","overlapping / ambiguous call"]
vals=[c.get(o,0) for o in order]
colors=["#8064a2","#9bbb59","#4f81bd","#c0504d","#bfbfbf"]
ax[0].barh(range(len(order)),vals,color=colors)
ax[0].set_yticks(range(len(order)))
ax[0].set_yticklabels([o.replace(" (","\n(") for o in order],fontsize=8)
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax[0].text(v+2,i,str(v),va="center",fontsize=9)
ax[0].invert_yaxis(); ax[0].set_xlabel("number of fungal species")
ax[0].set_title("Compara ortholog calls across %d fungal species"%len(allsp))

r=json.load(open("erg13_dnds_unsaturated_provenance.json"))[0]
labs=["dS","dN","dN/dS"]; va=[r["dS_A"],r["dN_A"],r["omega_A"]]; vb=[r["dS_B"],r["dN_B"],r["omega_B"]]
x=np.arange(3); w=0.38
ax[1].bar(x-w/2,va,w,color="#c0504d",label="A-type (erg13A lineage)")
ax[1].bar(x+w/2,vb,w,color="#4f81bd",label="B-type (erg13B lineage)")
for xi,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(va,vb)): ax[1].text(xi,max(a,b)*1.05,f"{a/b:.2f}x",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax[1].set_xticks(x); ax[1].set_xticklabels(labs); ax[1].legend(fontsize=8)
ax[1].set_ylabel("substitutions per site, or ratio")
ax[1].set_title("A. fumigatus vs A. fischeri, dS unsaturated\n(pS = 0.19 and 0.11)")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
